whenToUse: Postal, billing or shipping addresses on customer, company, branch or invoice forms.
Turkish addresses where province and district must come from a fixed list.
avoidWhen: A single free-text location like a meeting place — use Input.
Picking a stored branch or warehouse — use Select or Record picker.
a11y: Renders a fieldset with a legend; give it a label that names the address (Billing address).
Each sub-field keeps its own visible label and autocomplete token.
